## 3. Findings
F-001 [S4]
Where: crates/product-config/tests/fixtures/unknown-top-level.toml:27 (vs product.toml:27)
Code (fixture):
```
display_version = "0.1.0-dev"
```
Code (real product.toml):
```
display_version = "0.1.3"
```
What is wrong: the fixture base is a STALE snapshot of product.toml (diff: display_version 0.1.0-dev vs 0.1.3; version_code 1 vs 4; min_width/min_height 480/320 vs 940/600; streaming-http false vs true; `[web.size_budgets]` entirely absent). The README (fixtures/README.md:5-7) admits the generation script "was a one-off" and fixtures are to be regenerated by hand — nobody did. The mutation still works (I verified all stale values sit inside the CURRENT schema bounds: min_width 480 ≥ schema minimum 320, display_version matches the version pattern — python3 schema check), and `semantic_diagnostics`-style tests would panic on structural drift (`unreachable!("must pass structural validation")`), but the fixtures-matrix tests only pin the TARGET key's diagnostic count (`one()`), so extra drift diagnostics elsewhere would be invisible. Why it matters: the fixture suite no longer exercises the current product.toml shape (e.g. nothing fixture-tests a base carrying `[web]`).
Confidence: HIGH — Verification: diff + python3 tomllib/schema checks (all run).
